evidence: Carries the Scripts and tools label and modifies `contrib/verify-binaries/verify.py`.
rationale: Fixes a major verification flaw where `verify.py` counted untrusted keys towards the required threshold. As stated in the description, `num_trusted` was computed as `len(good_trusted) + len(good_untrusted)`, allowing any valid signatures in the local GPG keyring to satisfy `--min-good-sigs` without matching `--trusted-keys`, while also addressing short key IDs, revoked keys, and duplicate signers.
